content.actualUserDirection: Complete the common Harness first: end-to-end final Plan review, real implementation, commit, push, PR and explicit Lead merge. WSL2/VPS Leads later pull that completed main and improve/activate their own runtime harnesses.
content.outcome: A Git-centered common Harness that reads real typed Work records portably from committed Git objects, validates meaningful semantic transitions, supplies bounded dependency context and shared docs routes, and is reproducibly verified and merged into main.

include: Small git-work API in the existing work-continuity package
Minimal explicitly admitted neutral identity/operational-state invariants
One portable docs-only Runtime Index source and selector
The selected actual Work's required canonical records and original-answer bindings
Common CLI, source admission, finite QA fixture succession and meaningful Git integration tests
Existing PR2 quality foundation, its four unresolved findings and removal of redundant review-arrival observer
Exact-tree independent code review, authenticated receipt/status publication, PR checks, explicit merge and post-merge readback
WSL2/VPS Lead handoff containing source/API usage, verified common milestone and deferred native responsibilities
defer: Runtime-specific hook, fork, tool-route, session, Kanban, native reader, transport or permission improvements
Moving active checkouts or changing global/native configuration, serving images, profiles, sessions or trust
Original/evidence/native-store relocation, whole-history/private capture import or paused Hermes/Wiki effects
Paid/native model evaluation suite and original both-runtime whole-Work Acceptance

sourceBaseline.remoteMain: Clean isolated origin/main; original dirty/private owner checkouts remain source evidence
sourceBaseline.qualityFoundation: Apply exact PR2 commit 0cc96d15a9795fc008286b2dec54cbb7641646e3 via git cherry-pick --no-commit after independent Plan closure, recording original commit/tree/diff provenance. Fix all four findings before a new independently reviewed candidate; no old review reuse or ancestor merge of PR2.
sourceBaseline.unpublishedContracts: Remote main lacks interview-history. Explicitly promote only needed neutral identity/state predicates into the common package; do not import active absolute paths or the whole corpus engine.
sourceBaseline.nativePackages: All 20 PR2 native TypeScript deltas were independently shown to emit identical Bun JavaScript to ffba main; this is source equivalence only. Restore both exact main native-task-controls plugin blobs, their two sourcePins, the full six-item nativePluginSources list and exact-six CI validation after foundation import. No runtime-specific behavior improvement or active native mutation.
sourceBaseline.immutableReleases: Preserve every existing Ontology0.1/0.2 archive byte and native domain ownership

commonApi.records: Discriminated typed Work, Spec, Plan, Task, actual-decision, relation, effect/fence, evidence and original-input contracts; reuse immutable Ontology envelopes where applicable
commonApi.identity: Domain/Project/Work/Issue/Spec+revision/Plan+revision/Task remain logical IDs. Work path includes Project/Work ownership; per-ID filenames are deterministic and safe. No mutable whole-Task index.
commonApi.sourceRefs: Same-snapshot refs persist relative path and exact fragment/content identity, resolved under caller repository+commit. External Git refs pin an existing commit; native/original refs retain their owner's locator/receipt. Never embed a commit's own SHA in its content.
commonApi.sourceReader: Native Git argument-array object/ref reads, exact commit and regular blob mode, bounded input, no shell interpolation or implicit network fetch. Reject traversal, symlinks/submodules and wrong scope. Committed bytes remain distinct from mutable execution paths.
commonApi.context: Read selected purpose/current governing decisions and selected Task/dependency/source closure. Missing required inputs hold dependent qualification; unrelated history remains diagnostic. Exceeding a bound returns an explicit hold/omission rather than silently dropping governing meaning.
commonApi.start: Native owner supplies a fresh remote-main observation for new Work. Validate it against the selected baseline; unobserved/stale assertions cannot claim freshness. Same Work keeps its branch/IDs. No automatic fetch/reset/rebase/merge is hidden in qualification.
commonApi.provenance: Bind actual answer and selection context to original source fragments; reject a proposal or changed literal claimed as an actual answer. Native owner remains responsible for authenticating user authorship/custody; common results grant no permission.
commonApi.operationalState: Preserve execution, verification, local durability, shared delivery and formal completion as separate axes; reuse current invariant semantics. Downstream locally durable prerequisites require exact occurrence/producer/receiver evidence when crossing runtime.
commonApi.transitions: Retain completed/uncertain effect fences and source history; reject replay, loss, invalid supersession, selected dependency cycles and clean textual integrations with invalid combined completion/prerequisite state.
commonApi.legacy: Preserve currently public handoff/checkpoint exports and finite owner import/first-import tests. Git-native canonical source avoids base64/whole-checkpoint CAS on the new route; compatibility remains until runtime Leads migrate their callers.
commonApi.cli: Small Bun context/validate/transition/start/source commands consuming the common APIs; no executor, scheduler, native session store or provider client

runtimeIndex.source: Existing reviewed84-route runtime/version/topic registry with original source metadata and official URL restrictions
runtimeIndex.implementation: Validate the immutable registry once per reader instance; select subject/topic/host companions with bounded results. Remove the duplicate native-execution/approval/billing status layer. Native tools/permissions and native document parsers remain owners.
runtimeIndex.hostBinding: Generated path-neutral host-pointer recipe; each future Lead binds its actual checkout/reader. No live WSL2/VPS pointer publication in this PR.

actualWorkBaseline.governingDirection: Retain actual-decisions-v6 plus this new explicit implementation/publication direction and needed U1-U28 original fragments/status/supersession context
actualWorkBaseline.purpose: Preserve original North-Star and whole-Work goal, with this common-source milestone and deferred runtime scope explicitly distinct
actualWorkBaseline.records: Real Spec5/Plan5/Task identity, meaningful dependencies/relations, original-answer inputs and precise source verification/evidence references
actualWorkBaseline.historicalEffects: Conservatively preserve completed/uncertain IDs as historical no-replay fences; do not invent native attempt/occurrence IDs or verification for unavailable old receipts
actualWorkBaseline.publicationTruth: Authored source records describe their actual pre-publication state. Git/PR and external owner receipts establish later publication; do not create a self-referential commit/status cycle or claim native activation.

repairFindings: Run architecture/quality checks on the prospective merge as well as authored head
Govern compatibility source adapters and verify forwarding-only ownership
Build immutable generated Ontology output separately and compare before replacement
Scan maintained tracked documentation for secrets while retaining explicit original/history/release/private exclusions
ciAndPublication.simplification: Remove the333-line automatic review-arrival observer and32availability lines while retaining the required named independent-review job and trustedv2validator. No poller or replacement observer.
ciAndPublication.beforePr: Complete checks, commit and freeze the final candidate; independent native reviewer reviews the exact commit/tree and current findings. Any subsequent tree change requires renewed review. Push, publish immutable truthful independent result/receipt plus authenticated status, then open PR.
ciAndPublication.beforeMerge: Check current head/base, required jobs/status publisher, source manifest/tree, current review findings/threads and tests. Fix findings and re-review changed source. Root Lead explicitly invokes merge with expected head; automatic merge remains disabled.
ciAndPublication.afterMerge: Read actual merged main/tree. For a new merge SHA with identical reviewed tree, have the independent reviewer bind the successor and current finding state, publish a successor receipt/status and target-rerun the required review job if its first attempt raced. A changed tree requires a fresh review.
ciAndPublication.publisher: Native GitHub MCP where equivalent; existing authenticated official gh for commit-status write absent from MCP. No new connector/client.

acceptance.sourceTests: All ten COMMON-GIT criteria in plan-common-api.json, including fresh clone portability, independent Task writes, original fragment mismatch, semantic merge conflict, completed/uncertain fences, receipt/receiver separation, dependency-only holds, freshness, unsafe Git inputs, legacy compatibility, actual Work records and docs-only selection
requiredChecks: focused Git-work integration suite and TypeScript checks
full affected quality suite on authored head and prospective merge
acceptance.independentReview: Zero unresolved findings for exact source subject; provenance/result/manifest and successor reuse verified
acceptance.delivery: Commit pushed, PR checked, explicit Lead merge, exact merged main readback and common CLI/Work validation from that revision
acceptance.scope: Common-source implementation and publication only; runtime-native adoption and original whole-Work Acceptance remain separate
